name: hermes-agent
description: An AI agent with advanced tool-calling capabilities, featuring a flexible toolsets system for organizing and managing tools.

scripts.postinstall: echo '✅ Browser tools ready. Run: python run_agent.py --help'
scripts.mygit: eval $(bash scripts/get_proxy.sh) && source venv/bin/activate && python3 scripts/mygit.py
scripts.mygit:full: eval $(bash scripts/get_proxy.sh) && source venv/bin/activate && python3 scripts/mygit.py
scripts.chat: eval $(bash scripts/get_proxy.sh) && source venv/bin/activate && hermes chat
scripts.config: eval $(bash scripts/get_proxy.sh) && source venv/bin/activate && hermes config
scripts.skills: eval $(bash scripts/get_proxy.sh) && source venv/bin/activate && hermes skills
scripts.gateway: eval $(bash scripts/get_proxy.sh) && source venv/bin/activate && hermes gateway
